body.description: Fields to change on the subscription.

schema.description: Fields accepted when updating a subscription. `IdOffer`, `IdCustomer`, `IdCustomerBuyer`, `DurationRecurrence`, and `UnitRecurrence` are set at creation and read-only afterwards. The billing period dates (`DatePeriodStart`, `DatePeriodEnd`, `DateTerm`), `IsTrial`, `IsPriced`, and `CountPeriodsNonTrial` are computed by ProAbono. `Status` is read-only and derived from `StateSubscription` — set `StateSubscription`, not `Status`.

DateStart.description: Subscription start date. Updatable only while the subscription has not started; once it has, the start date is fixed.

StateSubscription.description:
Granular technical state of a subscription.

* `DraftCustomer` — draft initiated by the customer without completing signup (`Status` = `Draft`)
* `DraftAgent` — draft created by an agent (`Draft`)
* `DraftDelayedStart` — subscription with a scheduled start date (`Draft`)
* `DraftDelayedUpgrade` — subscription replacing an active one on its next term (`Draft`)
* `ActiveRunning` — currently operational (`Active`)
* `ActiveDelayedUpgrade` — being replaced by a new subscription at next renewal (`Active`)
* `ActiveDelayedTermination` — will terminate at next renewal (`Active`)
* `ActiveDelayedSuspension` — will be suspended at next renewal (`Active`)
* `SuspendedAgent` — suspended by an agent (`Suspended`)
* `SuspendedNoPaymentInfo` — suspended automatically: payment information missing (`Suspended`)
* `SuspendedPaymentDue` — suspended automatically: too many unpaid invoices (`Suspended`)
* `EndedComplete` — time-limited subscription that ran its full course (`Ended`)
* `EndedUpgrade` — terminated after a plan change (`Ended`)
* `EndedTerminated` — explicitly terminated (`Ended`)
* `Deleted` — subscription in deletion process (`Deleted`)
StateSubscription.title: StateSubscription

Metadata.description: Set of key/value pairs attached to the object, up to five keys. Writable at creation and on every update of the parent object. On an update, send a key with an empty value to unset that key, or send an empty value for `Metadata` to clear every key.
Metadata.title: Metadata
